entities.summary: Guillermo Enrique Billinghurst Angulo was a Peruvian politician who served as the 37th President of Peru. He succeeded Augusto B. Leguía, from 1912 to 1914. An Anglo-Peruvian, Billinghurst's surname is a locational name; Billingshurst is a small town and civil parish in Sussex. Guillermo Billinghurst was a performers & entertainers from Arica (1851-07-27, Arica–1915-06-28). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
